acceptanceCriteria: staleness is computed against the candidate revision named by the witness request, with a regression test where HEAD and candidate differ
the staleness basis is recorded in the witness output
body: Residual from #1189 (TOL-V0-073..078). Reviewed-witness crediting computes review staleness only at read time and against the store HEAD, not the candidate revision under review, so a verdict can be counted fresh for a candidate it never saw, or stale for one it did.
title: Review staleness is read-time only and judged at store HEAD instead of the candidate revision
